# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.57

- **Hardware tutorial: worked example** from the annex supplied by Alexandru Dumbravă (29 scanned pages of a manual printed in 1995): processed with the `book-bw` profile, Romanian OCR on, PDF out. Measured: 29 of 29 pages, 4.3 MB in and 2.1 MB out, skew between −0.7° and +0.1°, 9006 words, two-column text in the right reading order. Remaining mistakes (small letters, s/ș and t/ț) are stated in the tutorial. Eight languages.
- Pages of the book are **not** included in the repository or the tutorial (publisher's copyright); the annex was used only as a local test.
